name: combo2_resolution
description: Settle whether the automatic ACT_MELEE_ATTACK_2COMBO substitution ever reaches a played sequence. CWeaponMelee::RequestActivity re-enters itself with 0x4d on a winning ability draw, so every press should show TWO calls when the draw wins: the outer 0x4b and the inner 0x4d. The inner call's return value is the whole question - 1 committed the combo, 0 refused it and the outer call fell through to the ordinary attack. Deliberately excludes the per-frame targets in life5_attack_chain: they burn the trace budget before a swing arrives.
